request.voice_description: A ravenous undead ghoul creature from a dark fantasy film. Extremely low, gravelly, croaking male voice with heavy vocal fry, a wet raspy throat and rotten breath; slurred, dim-witted broken English, greedy and hungry, growling between words.
request.text: [low growl] Hhhrrrr... Must... feed! [wet raspy breathing] Me eat brains! Hhhhaaah... me eat dead people... [snarls] Grrrrr... me scary! [hungry panting]
